independent_outcome_recheck.meaning: Re-executes curated local code and checks saved decision artifacts; this is not another agent behavior run.

limitations: These are scoped observations, not proof of universal unattended delivery or future bug-free production behavior.
There is no unskilled-agent control or randomized repeat benchmark; code-baseline regressions are not evidence of causal skill improvement.
Only the CSV follow-up used the guarded entrypoint; the other four decision cases were not rerun after the narrow edit.
Entrypoint hashes identify SKILL.md, not an immutable snapshot of all support files, tools, model configuration or provider environment.

The scenarios deliberately prohibit network and paid effects. Readiness, accounting and disclosure decisions are assessed from synthetic artifacts and reviewed execution reports, not live service outcomes.
Curated evidence omits internal transcripts, local account metadata and absolute home paths. Baseline traceback workspace prefixes are normalized to <workspace> without changing assertion output.
